summary:
Implementation plan covering all 9 requested features and fixes:
1. Live Email OTP Verification (SMTP + Resend API integration + Sandbox Inspector)
2. Live Auction Timers showing remaining days, hours, minutes, and seconds
3. Animated Video Guide & Walkthrough in How It Works (Register, Login, Deposit, Bid, View Results)
4. Enable Super Admin Live Auction Edit functionality
5. Enforce 3 attempts duplicate transaction flagging & Super Admin notifications
6. Auto-compress approved deposit receipt images to under 100KB to save workspace memory
7. Restrict operations admins to their allocated deposit requests only
8. Fix Super Admin live auction game radar selection retention
9. Optimize system data storage and reduce unnecessary memory consumption
